anchor.citation: Boucher Y, Salehi H, Witwer B, Harsh GR, Jain RK. Interstitial fluid pressure in intracranial tumours in patients and in rodents. Br J Cancer 1997;75(6):829-836.
anchor.spread_evidence: Statistical analysis, verbatim: "The data are presented as the mean +/- standard deviation." An SEM reading is additionally impossible: SEM 2.5 at n=11 would imply SD 8.3, which cannot be produced by 11 values of which 10 lie in 0.0-3.0.
anchor.technique: wick-in-needle (Boucher et al 1991), intraoperative, after opening of the intracranial cavity and removal of the dura
anchor.confound: all 11 patients received dexamethasone 10 mg + mannitol 0.5 mg/kg + furosemide 20 mg i.v. pre-operatively and were hyperventilated to PaCO2 25-32 mmHg; the authors conclude antioedema therapy is responsible in part for the low IFP
